projection.name: elasticsearch
projection.title: Elasticsearch
projection.description: Elasticsearch cockpit with cluster health, indices, mappings, settings, shards, documents, JSON DSL search, and document/index operations.

fields.label: Read-only mode
fields.help: Blocks document writes, index creation, close/open, reindex, and deletes.

config.label: Elasticsearch query

actions.label: Delete
actions.confirmText: Delete this index and all documents?

actions.label: Delete by query
actions.confirmText: Delete all documents matching this query? This cannot be undone.

fields.label: Query
fields.help: Query DSL selecting the documents to delete, e.g. {"match":{"status":"archived"}}.

fields.label: Filter
fields.help: Optional query DSL to make this a filtered alias.
